Headline: #63 63rd buses Temporary Reroute near 63rd/Stewart
ShortDescription: The #63 63rd buses are temporarily rerouted, due to construction near 63rd/Stewart.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

Westbound #63 63rd buses are temporarily rerouted via 63rd, Wentworth, 59th, Halsted, 63rd and then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to construction near 63rd/Stewart.

Headline: O'Hare-bound Blue Line Delays
ShortDescription: O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are running w/major delays following an earlier mechanical problem near Cicero (Congress). Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are running with major delays following an earlier mechanical problem on a train near Cicero (Congress).

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Shuttle buses have been requested to provide connecting service between UIC/Halsted and Forest Park, in both directions until 5:45pm.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
